name: zfmv_action_image_end
description: zFMV_ActionImage::End releases a non-null image through zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault and clears the image field; a null image is ignored.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zFMV image action/source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4633a0 validates the MSVC thiscall shape: load image from offset 12, skip work when it is null, call zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault for a non-null image, clear image to null, and return without a value.
The native smoke verifies that a null image does not call the release helper and that a non-null image is passed to the accepted zVid_Image::ReleaseIfNotDefault dependency and then cleared.
